facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx, Push Square)
facts.saves: 15 manual slots + 1 autosave; no mission replay; free roam continues after the story

roadmap.text: Finish the five chapters at your own pace. Along the way, do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude), take optional missions as they appear (100% needs any 100 of several hundred), scan new vehicles with WAiNK (100% needs 200 of 277 base models) and study new animals through the binoculars (100% needs 100 of 255). There are no mission medals and no mission replay, so keep a save at the start and end of each chapter. Everything else can wait until after the story.
roadmap.title: Play the story, and protect the one missable

roadmap.text: After the story, the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The bar is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Most of the grind trophies land during this step.
roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and the challenges

roadmap.text: Strangers & Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so finish the 8 stranger strands last, mop up anything left on the list, and Vice Got a Price! follows. One playthrough is enough; keep cheats off the whole run, since they disable trophies and saving.
roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks, then the platinum

sixshore.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. No multiplayer and no DLC is involved — every trophy in the set is single-player and offline, so the platinum is purely a matter of finishing the list. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it the 100% completion checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish the opening main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 1; PowerPyx notes it pops a little late, after the first mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; like the Chapter 1 trophy it pops a little late, after the first mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City), according to PowerPyx.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed, and the only gold among the story trophies. Finish the final mission and it pops. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing is locked off by reaching the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. Both PowerPyx and Push Square call it the hardest trophy, but the bar is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Expect about 100 hours of cleanup after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map's Exploration list also shows each stunt spot by name.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Check your tally under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them. Most players get this without trying while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The 100% checklist needs every range as well, so this is not a detour. PowerPyx has a guide to all 12 range locations and their 42 gold medals.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). The 100% checklist needs all of them too. PowerPyx lists every location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you only need half of them — pick the ones you are comfortable with. PowerPyx lists all 40 locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After you meet him in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento, marked with a purple icon on the map. Go there and win the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind play on the TV at home (available from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck runs on arcade machines around the world. Reaching the end of one game is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest strand. It is Lucia only: during Chapter 3 she calls you, then texts her address in Belville, and the strand runs through five quests ending with Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: clear 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to him. He marks purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor. He goes quiet after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 while you play as Jason (calling Brian speeds it up), so this is not missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and all five quests — ending with Hometown Heroes — stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and PowerPyx notes more are still being found. All of them stay available after the story in free roam; watch the count on the trophy tracker. This is the one silver that is not part of the 100% checklist, so it often ends up last.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list: deliver 16 sports cars. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end cars. Randy marks some cars for you in fixed spots, but you can steal them off the street too — scan a car with WAiNK to see whether it is on his list, then drive it to his garage in the west of Vice City. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Delivering in good condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand, Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers show the synthetic labs around Vice City — destroy them (Take Out Kitty Litter), and Tyrone then hands you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down for good. Available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts double. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx flags: one meditation at Jason's house exists only in Chapter 1. After the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the optional quest. It raises your counter by one but is not marked as a spot, so nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do it when it appears; it takes a minute. You cannot finish the last meditation until both characters can roam together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.when: Chapter 1 onwards — one meditation is Chapter 1 only

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County; on that first quest he hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle. Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx says finishing all 15 of Bret's target decks (required for the 100% checklist anyway) should cover it. Track the decks under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. You only need three, so pick the sets whose cards you find first. PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold up, then R1): landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are more than 100 of them, so scan whatever you pass. PowerPyx breaks the set down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the corner marks the finished ones. Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies; leave the hardest 10 alone and pick the easy ones last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. It opens in Chapter 2, after Coffee Break, when the two can roam together — call your partner with the D-pad and triangle prompt. Bank vault robberies give 4 stars automatically, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal. PowerPyx's easy escape is a fast motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow; the trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level. Start after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Hit three robbery targets back to back without losing the flashing wanted level — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, so hit a fourth if it does not. A good run is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; rob a few items in each and break the safe in the back room. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with WAiNK is enough — you never have to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic; with 557 vehicles in the game, 100 comes quickly. Check your tally under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep at it.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming), which slows time for a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drink or adrenaline, wear body armor, and use an assault rifle against gang members at a gang operation — soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count. It gets easier as focus levels up (through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots), and many players earn it naturally by the end.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. It has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the parked ones on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. The unlock is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and fire at the soldiers until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed back doors and unlocks jewelry store robberies. Enter through the back with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good pick.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. Afterwards, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each (after his earlier quests). There are 8 vaults and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. Each robbery gives 4 stars instantly; a fast motorcycle is the getaway, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. A vault can pay up to $205,000, the best late-game earner.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing the truck that delivered the cash. For an earlier method, block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map, all 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the remaining black patches. PowerPyx has a guide to unfogging the map fast, including the best plane for the job.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops early in that cleanup.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. PowerPyx confirmed this method; other guides still listed the trophy as unknown, so treat it as fresh information.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in one specific car: the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward straight through the window, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are out on the street. Only this Banshee counts — it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy some at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. Not missable: if you miss an item during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, the robbery respawns later and you can grab what is left; the three items do not need to be taken in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It opens in Chapter 2, after Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at a fitness club (filter the map for Activities) with your partner along — while one character trains, the other progresses too, so you build both at once. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia. Note: Push Square does not list this one as hidden, while PSNProfiles and Exophase do.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications) and you will see a small demon face each time an action registers — stealthy robberies, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count. It builds passively through every robbery and encounter, so most players get it while working on the other trophies. Check your count by opening the trophy in your trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed by any guide. PowerPyx believes it is linked to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and lists it as unknown. This guide will not invent a method: check the PowerPyx trophy guide for updates, and treat any other claim as unconfirmed until a second source backs it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back, since the spawn is slightly random. Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While riding any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with the melee button within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it — keep moving and keep kicking.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then bring marked bills from bank and Payday Loans robberies to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total adds up across robberies, so you never need to carry it all at once; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest and get you there fastest; with 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops and 11 tattoo studios around Leonida, you will not run out of places to spend it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 in total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the cash, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3–4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes, and use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down. Later, from Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: On the Spot

verified: Names, descriptions and grades checked against the starter list (Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing) and PowerPyx's full trophy guide, read 2026-11-20. Methods paraphrased in our own words from the cited guides; nothing copied.
